annotations.title: Verify a crawler log (real vs forged bots)

description: Checks raw access-log lines (up to 200) and returns, for each line that names a crawler, verified, spoofed or unverifiable, by testing the source IP against that operator's published ranges. Use on your own server logs. For crawler traffic seen at crawlcheck.io itself use telemetry; for which crawlers can reach a domain use crawler_path.

lines.description: Up to 200 raw log lines, newline separated
